sections.title: Vidhi Transport Co.
intro: Vidhi Transport Co. provides road-logistics services for industrial customers across Gujarat and Maharashtra. The website presents the company's services, 14 listed branch locations, customer-care contacts and published credentials.

Disclosure policy: Only a business whose legal identity, relationship and service responsibility have been verified is listed as a group company. Vidhi Transport Co. is the currently confirmed operating identity for this website.

sections.title: Group and legal-identity questions.
intro: This page intentionally presents only verified business information.

faqs.q: Which company is confirmed on this website?
faqs.a: Vidhi Transport Co. is the confirmed operating identity currently represented on this website. No additional legal entity is presented as a group company without verified information.

faqs.q: Is warehousing a separate group company?
faqs.a: No separate warehousing legal entity is represented on this page. Warehousing and distribution appear as Vidhi Transport service capabilities, subject to facility availability and an agreed scope.

faqs.q: How will another group company be added?
faqs.a: Its official legal name, relationship to Vidhi Transport, service scope, responsibility and approved contact information should be verified before publication.

faqs.q: Where can a procurement team request legal or onboarding documents?
faqs.a: Contact Vidhi Transport through customercare@vidhitransport.com or the published customer-care number and identify the specific document required for vendor onboarding.
